name: candlekeep
lore:
Perched atop a jagged volcanic crag overlooking the Sea of Swords, **Candlekeep** stands as the preeminent bastion of enlightenment in Faerûn. This formidable fortress-library is not merely a collection of parchment; it is the living memory of the world.

### History & Foundation
Established millennia ago, the keep’s legacy is inextricably bound to Alaundo the Seer. Following his passing, the sage’s singular prophecies became the foundation of the library’s mission. The **Avowed**—a cloistered order of scholar-monks—have since dedicated their lives to the preservation of every scrap of lore, from mundane genealogies to the forbidden rites of lost empires.

### Significance: The Price of Wisdom
To pass through the Emerald Door, an adventurer must pay the "Great Library’s Toll": a gift of a book or scroll of significant value not already present within the vaults. This policy ensures Candlekeep remains an ever-growing ocean of thought. Within the Inner Ward, the silence is heavy with the scent of vellum and ancient dust. It is the ultimate destination for those seeking to break a curse, locate a lost city, or interpret the movements of the gods.

### Legends & Whispers
Scholars whisper that Alaundo’s spirit still wanders the Echoing Halls, chanting prophecies yet to be fulfilled. More unsettling are the rumors of the "Catacombs of the Deep," subterranean vaults where sentient grimoires and lethal wards guard secrets deemed too volatile for mortal eyes. 

Beware, traveler: while knowledge is a light that guides the way, in the towering spires of Candlekeep, the shadows it casts are long and remarkably deep. Pack your inkwell, guard your tongue, and respect the silence.
